item.title: Best Smart Plugs to Eliminate Standby Power Drain
item.description:
Disclosure: Some links in this article are affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. This never affects our recommendations — see our affiliate policy.

Quick Answer

Smart plugs can reduce standby power costs by automatically cutting power to devices, saving $50-150 per year on average. Phantom loads account for 5-10% of residential electricity use, costing the average household $100-200 annually for devices that appear “off” but still draw power.
